'''2000 Decipher World Championship Kyle Craft Craft's worlds decks''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Kyle Craft]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 3rd at [[2000 Decipher World Championship]]. The post says: "This is the dark deck that i played all three days of worlds.  I got third." (2000 Decipher World Championship, 5–7 October 2000; Day 3 3rd).<ref name="dt-11049">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11049 Craft's worlds decks], DeckTech (Kyle "Jedi.02" Craft, 10 October 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11049/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11049/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018110550/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11049/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
